name: Dongbu Corporation
summary: Based in Seoul, South Korea, Dongbu Corporation is a prominent construction contractor with diverse operations across various sectors. The company delivers end-to-end engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for industrial facilities, including power, energy, environmental, and petrochemical plants. Its portfolio also encompasses significant civil infrastructure projects, such as roads, bridges, tunnels, rail systems, and port facilities, alongside a wide array of buildings, from medical and public institutions to commercial, sports, and leisure complexes. Beyond general construction, Dongbu Corporation specializes in residential and mixed-use developments, constructing condominium complexes and leading various real estate projects, including resorts, industrial parks, commercial centers, and office buildings. They further extend their expertise to property and facility management, alongside offering leasing and sales brokerage services. The company's extensive engineering services span the entire project lifecycle, from initial planning, feasibility studies, and value engineering to conceptual and detailed design, construction supervision, and comprehensive project management. They also provide consultancy and advisory services across numerous domains, including civil infrastructure, transportation, rail systems, geotechnical engineering, water resource management (supply and treatment), environmental solutions, landscape architecture, and geographic information systems (GIS). Established in 1969, the company initially operated as Miryung Engineering & Construction Co. Ltd. before rebranding to Dongbu Corporation in March 1989.
